status: Pat's item 57 (board3/WEAPON-LIMITS.md, picked 2.5x): the weapon box is 2.5x today's largest weapon plus 10%; every other value is /1's. An item opts in with "limits": "trenchie-item-limits/2"; an item without that field is /1 and keeps validating under limits.json. A /2 weapon is authored at its full size, so it is drawn at weapon_render_scale 1, never at the 2.5x mount scale /1 weapons are drawn at.
